title: 1x M2 medium (1L) Preparation
author: Sarah Seyffert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uquevww
materials: The medium has to be autoclaved afterwards

steps.title: Maintain sterility
steps.instruction: Perform all subsequent manipulations under sterile conditions (e.g., in a biosafety cabinet).

steps.title: Add 100x M2 stock
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of the 100× M2 stock solution to the vessel.

steps.title: Add 100x K2HPO4 stock
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of the 100× K₂HPO₄ stock (prepared at 82 g L⁻¹).

steps.title: Add 1000x Na2CO3
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the 1000× Na₂CO₃ stock (provides 20 mg L⁻¹ in the final medium).

steps.title: Add 1000x trace metals
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the 1000× trace‑metal stock. The stock contains (per litre): H₃BO₃ 2.86 g, MnCl₂·4H₂O 1.81 g, ZnSO₄·7H₂O 0.222 g, Na₂MoO₄·2H₂O 0.390 g, Co(NO₃)₂·6H₂O 0.049 g.

steps.title: Add HEPES buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 g of HEPES to the mixture.

steps.title: Add 1000x Fe(III) citrate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the 1000× Fe(III) ammonium citrate stock (final concentration 6 mg L⁻¹).

steps.title: Add 5000x CuSO4 solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the 5000× CuSO₄·5H₂O stock (final concentration 395 ng mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Adjust volume to 1 L
steps.instruction: Add MilliQ water to bring the total volume to 1 L.
